fail_condition: formal adapter obtains FINITE query status and float(query.h) < 0.0
full_frozen_interface_reference: certify_current_feasibility classifies map snapshot mismatch, UNKNOWN/NONFINITE/ERROR query states, h<0 infeasibility, and optional candidate residual; the formal adapter uses only the direct current-map-query subset
map_authority_dependency: provider query is bound to the frozen map authority id and FULL query scope
pass_condition: formal adapter obtains FINITE query status and float(query.h) >= 0.0
start_safe_admission_relation: L0 is the frozen current-feasibility admission stage; the formal closure performs no repair
state_checked: p_k current position from the immutable committed-step payload
unknown_condition: formal adapter obtains a query status other than FINITE and preserves query.reason_code
